dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: How exhausting... but I'll grit my teeth and keep training!

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: Just like Gaming says, one second on stage is the result of ten years of off-stage training.

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: If I don't train hard, my punches will hit like wet noodles and I might trip over my own spear or stab myself with my sword in battle. It'll be too late for regrets then!
